notes: Both object markers are unrepresented: the ASV writes the objects bare (rule 16).
In 'the iniquity of the sanctuary' the rectum is rendered arthrously, so its article takes t021 and the construct takes the supplied t018 (rule 29).
In 'the iniquity of your priesthood' the rectum's own word carries the possessive 'your' from the suffix, so nothing is fronted and the construct takes the supplied 'the' (rules 29, 41).
